distinctness.vs_commodity_breakout: broad 156-symbol universe and broker-native tick-volume confirmation, no true-range expansion filter
distinctness.vs_tick_volume_shock_reversal: continuation after multi-bar range break, not reversal after one-bar price/volume shock

universe_rule.outcome_blind: reuse timestamp/identity-only 156-symbol DEVELOPMENT universe: >=40 ISO weeks and >=30000 M5 rows; HIGH_QUALITY delta supersedes duplicate symbol IDs

signal.reference_range: previous range_lookback_bars exact contiguous completed M5 highs/lows excluding signal bar t
signal.volume_reference: median tick_volume over previous 72 exact contiguous completed M5 bars excluding t; require positive median
signal.long_signal: close_t strictly above frozen prior range high AND volume confirmation
signal.short_signal: close_t strictly below frozen prior range low AND volume confirmation
signal.entry: next exact contiguous M5 open after completed signal bar
signal.failure_exit: LONG first completed post-entry close <= frozen prior range high; SHORT first completed post-entry close >= frozen prior range low; execute next open
signal.time_exit: next open after maximum_hold_bars completed post-entry bars if no failure
signal.overlap: one open event per symbol x cell
signal.missing: right-censor any required missing 300-second link; no interpolation or synthetic bars

multiplicity.family: all 1872 frozen symbol x parameter cells
multiplicity.support_rule_predeclared: All 1872 remain family members. Only cells meeting non-return support prerequisites (>=40 completed events, >=30 dates, >=20 ISO weeks, retention>=0.80) may generate finite max-T statistics; others receive p=1.

robust_region_gate.adjacency: one-step parameter-grid adjacency within same symbol
